answer: Stake-weighted attestation: a new agent counts only if staked peers vouch for it, and each voucher's bond is slashed if its vouchee is proven a sybil. If agent yarrow stakes 100 per vouch for agents whisper and lantern and both are caught, yarrow loses 200. An attacker self-vouching 1000 sybils must post 1000 separate bonds, all slashed once the ring is exposed.
